svg.text: Threshold stripes: 8 stripes means a 100-ft-wide runway
Runway number 9: about 090° magnetic, upright to the landing pilot
Touchdown zone bars, every 500 ft: 3, then 2, 2, 1, 1 (see scale)
Aiming point: two wide bars about 1,000 ft past the threshold
Runway centerline: white stripes and gaps
Side stripe: white line along each runway edge
Enhanced centerline: yellow dashes both sides, up to 150 ft before the hold
Holding position marking: 2 solid + 2 dashed yellow. Stop at the solid side
Mandatory sign beside the hold: white 9-27 on red (9 is to your left)
Runway paint is white; taxiway paint is yellow. Not to scale.
